description: Implementation of global functions and constants for the Android AAudio API, including policy management and conversion functions for various audio-related enums.

methods.name: AudioGlobal_getMMapPolicy
methods.description: Returns the current memory map policy setting.

methods.name: AudioGlobal_setMMapPolicy
methods.description: Sets the memory map policy; returns success or illegal argument error.

methods.name: AudioGlobal_convertResultToText
methods.description: Converts an aaudio_result_t code to its string representation.

methods.name: AudioGlobal_convertFormatToText
methods.description: Converts an aaudio_format_t enum to its string name.

methods.name: AudioGlobal_convertDirectionToText
methods.description: Converts an aaudio_direction_t enum to its string name.

methods.name: AudioGlobal_convertPerformanceModeToText
methods.description: Converts an aaudio_performance_mode_t enum to its string name.

methods.name: AudioGlobal_convertSharingModeToText
methods.description: Converts an aaudio_sharing_mode_t enum to its string name.

methods.name: AudioGlobal_convertStreamStateToText
methods.description: Converts an aaudio_stream_state_t enum to its string name.
